reason: This paper analyzes GPU LZ77 lossless decompression. It attributes throughput to average match length and adjusts the encoder minimum-match-length to improve compression ratio and the decode kernel; measurements are H100/device-resident generic data. It explicitly excludes entropy/host transfer timing and is not LLM weights, activations, KV cache, or serving compression. The corrupted lineage text does not establish a technical bridge.
title: What Governs Decode Throughput in Absolute-Offset GPU LZ77? A Work-Granularity Mechanism and an Encode-Time Min-Match-Length Lever
